projects.title: Western Command — Investiture Ceremony
projects.body: Ārohana handled the shoot and post-production for the Western Command Investiture Ceremony in February 2026. A disciplined, on-ground production covering ceremony coverage, final film delivery and post-production across a large-scale institutional event.

projects.title: 14 Corps Headquarters — Communication & Production
projects.body: Communication, design and video-production work, including visual communication and films developed through scripting, voice-over, editing and sound. The work required sensitivity to audience, environment and operational context.

projects.title: Fire & Fury Corps — Selected Work
projects.body: Fire & Fury is the designation associated with XIV Corps. Work includes communication, publications, video and community-facing initiatives — produced with the same discipline as any other institutional brief.

projects.title: Rezang La War Memorial — Coffee-table Book
projects.body: Coffee-table book design and visual communication for the Rezang La War Memorial. The publication required restraint, respect for the subject and clarity in a visually demanding format.

projects.title: 69 Armoured Regiment — Coffee-table Book
projects.body: Coffee-table book design and visual communication. The client-provided designation is 69 Armoured Regiment. Visuals are subject to public-use approval before publication.

projects.title: SHE — Sustainable Health Empowerment
projects.body: Health and hygiene initiative aligned with Operation Sadbhavana and implemented across eight remote villages. Ārohana developed the name and identity and worked across communication and documentary content. Sensitive community communication with responsibility at its centre.

projects.title: Operation Sampark
projects.body: Work with homestay owners in border communities on practical hospitality, hygiene and guest relations, including training material and a supporting video for Fire & Fury social media. On-ground, practical and built around real needs.

projects.title: Vibrant Villages Programme & Border Tourism
projects.body: Communication and video work connected with the Vibrant Villages Programme and border-tourism initiatives in Ladakh, including scripting, voice-over and production. Ārohana's contribution is communication and storytelling connected with these initiatives; the programme is not an Indian Army programme.
